# Fixture P3-PASS-ORDINARY Storyboard

01. Lin sees Mei's empty desk and the lunch card left beside the timetable.
02. Lin asks the custodian to keep the classroom open while they check the lost-property box.
03. Mei recalls placing the card in the box after lunch; they find it inside.
04. At the bus stop, Mei thanks Lin and repeats their promise to share tea the next morning.
05. The next morning Mei brings tea; Lin has saved the seat beside her.
